title: enhanced-unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for canary, A/B and shadow rollouts by unifying rollback decisioning and adding multi-stage probing/quarantine gates. This PR implements a modular autorollback engine that supports metric quorums, staged probing, conditional weighted canaries, and transparent shadow probing. It also adds telemetry and e2e tests to reduce flakiness in production rollouts. Changes are backward-compatible with existing rollout specs; legacy 'auto_rollback' boolean is mapped to the new policy schema during rollout read.

What this PR does: - Introduces rollout/autorollback engine with strategy plugins (canary, weighted, AB, shadow-probing) - Adds new rollout policy schema fields: "canary_weight_schedule", "preflight_probing", "quarantine_thresholds", "metric_quorum" - Implements multi-metric quorum evaluation and composite-metric thresholds - Adds staged probing: preflight -> probing -> quarantine -> exposure -> full - Wire up decision events to telemetry: rollout.rollback_decision, rollout.exposure_change, rollout.quarantine_entered - Add e2e tests covering canary->quarantine->auto-rollback and shadow probing path - Update console to show per-rollout decision traces and metric deltas for each stage - Add migration shim for legacy configs and a deprecation note in docs

Checklist: - [x] Design doc + Linear tickets referenced (ENG-4251, ENG-4268) - [x] Unit tests for quorum logic - [x] Integration tests for staged probing - [x] E2E stability tests added - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Backwards-compatible migration shim

Notes and links: Design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4251/autorollback-engine-design Related PRs: pr-136700-unified-rollouts-enhanced-observability-rollback-workflow.json, pr-121500-unified-rollouts-staged-canary-shadow-autorollback-enhancements.json. This PR intentionally keeps the runtime fast-path unchanged; decisioning runs in the rollout-controller process and emits lightweight signals to the serving runtime for immediate fallbacks.

feat(rollouts): implement multi-metric quorum evaluation and composite thresholds
feat(rollouts): staged probing and quarantine state machine
feat(observability): emit rollout.rollback_decision and rollout.exposure_change metrics
test(e2e): add canary-shadow-probing e2e tests and stability guards
docs(rollouts): migration guide and schema examples
chore(ci): add rollout e2e pipeline and flakiness retries
change_summary: Adds a unified autorollback engine and staged probing for safer rollouts; integrates telemetry and console traces; includes unit/integration/e2e tests and a migration shim for legacy configs.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: rollout decision engine could cause premature rollbacks if metric signals are noisy. Mitigation: defaults use conservative quorum sizes and stability windows; quarantine stage isolates noisy variants; feature gated behind rollout policy with sensible defaults; staged rollout to 1%/10%/50% schedule in CI tests.
review_comments: Dmitri Novak: Please add a unit test that covers mixed success/failure signals across metrics (e.g. latency increases while accuracy drops). Also prefer explicit timeouts for async probes to avoid leaks.
Aisha Patel (author): Added test_quorum.py covering mixed signals and added explicit timeouts to probe scheduler. PTAL.
Lina Chen: Can we expose rollback decision reasons in the console trace payload? It will help SRE debugging.
Aisha Patel: Console trace now includes 'decision_reason' and metric deltas; added schema example in docs/rollouts.md.
Carlos Mendez: e2e test flaked once in CI. Re-ran and it passed; consider a small retry wrapper in CI for known timing-sensitive tests.
Aisha Patel: Added flakiness retry (2 attempts) for rollout e2e tests in ci/pipelines/rollouts-e2e.yml and noted it in the PR description.
release_notes:
- Unified autorollback engine: multi-metric quorum and staged probing
- New rollout policy fields: canary_weight_schedule, preflight_probing, quarantine_thresholds, metric_quorum
- Rollout decision traces in Console (decision_reason + metric deltas)
- e2e tests for canary/shadow/quarantine flows
- Backwards-compatible migration shim for legacy auto_rollback configs
additional_context: This PR is a follow-up to ENG-4251 and hardens several failure modes observed during internal Dedicated canary rollouts in Q4 2025. The design favors conservative defaults and operator visibility; we plan a gradual rollout via feature flag and telemetry checks before enabling by default for all workspaces.
